question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word 'Plain' from the given sentence.

Mr. Das believes and follows the principle of simple living and high thinking.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Simple**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Plain"** means something that is simple and not elaborate or complicated. (सरल)

 
 
• **Example: **Her dress was plain but elegant.
 
 
 
• **"Simple" **refers to something that is easy to understand or not complicated, straightforward. (सरल)
 
 
• **Example: **The instructions were simple and easy to follow.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'plain' **is **'simple'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Simple**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **High **(उच्च): Great in rank, status, or quality.

 
 
• **Example:** He holds a high position in the company.
 
 
 
• **Principle **(सिद्धांत ): A fundamental truth or proposition that serves as the foundation for a system of belief or behavior.
 
 
• **Example: **He is a man of principle and always stands by his values.
 
 
 
• **Believes** (विश्वास करना): Accept (something) as true; feel sure of the truth of.
 
 
• **Example:** She believes in hard work and dedication.
